findings.title: Verify the intermediate wrap-affinity transition
findings.message: The round-trip assertion passes even if navigation does nothing at the wrap boundary, or moves logically forward and backward without crossing affinities. Consequently, this regression test can pass while the wrap-crossing behavior it claims to exercise is broken.
findings.suggestion: Assert immediately after cursorForward that the cursor retains the boundary offset and moves to the downstream visual line, then retain the existing reverse assertion.
